description: Creates a stack navigator for transitioning between screens in a stack-based navigation pattern. Each new screen is pushed onto the stack and can be popped back.

usage.staticAPI: createStackNavigator(config) returns a Stack Navigator object with Navigator and Screen components.
usage.dynamicAPI: Use <Stack.Navigator> and <Stack.Screen> in your component tree.

methods.Navigator: Component wrapping all stack screens and managing navigation state.
methods.Screen: Component representing an individual screen in the stack.

props.initialRouteName: Name of the first screen to display in the stack.
props.screenOptions: Default options to apply to all screens in the navigator.
props.detachInactiveScreens: Boolean to detach inactive screens to save memory (default true).
props.keyboardHandlingEnabled: Whether keyboard should automatically dismiss on navigation (default true).
props.headerMode: How header is rendered: 'float' (default iOS), 'screen', or 'none'.
props.mode: Deprecated, use 'presentation' in screen options instead ('card' or 'modal').
props.animation: Default animation for screen transitions: 'default', 'fade', 'slide_from_right', etc.

screenOptions.title: Fallback string for header title.
screenOptions.headerShown: Boolean to show or hide the header (default true).
screenOptions.header: Custom header component function receiving { navigation, route, options, back, layout, progress }.
screenOptions.headerTitleStyle: Style object for header title text.
screenOptions.headerBackTitle: Title for the back button on iOS.
screenOptions.gestureEnabled: Boolean to enable swipe gestures for dismissing the screen.
screenOptions.gestureResponseDistance: Distance from the edge for gesture recognition.

transitionAnimations.cardStyleInterpolator: Function to interpolate the style of the screen card during transition.
transitionAnimations.headerStyleInterpolator: Function to interpolate the style of the header during transition.
transitionAnimations.transitionSpec: Object to configure timing or spring animations with options like duration, damping, stiffness.

refMethods.push: Pushes a new screen on top of the stack.
refMethods.pop: Pops the current screen from the stack, optional count to pop multiple.
refMethods.popToTop: Pops all screens except the first one.
refMethods.replace: Replaces the current screen with a new screen.
refMethods.popTo: Pops back to a specific screen in the stack.

hooks.useCardAnimation: Returns animation values for the current and next screens, including progress, closing, swiping, inverted, layouts.

notes: Use screenOptions for default configuration of all screens.
Custom headers require specifying headerMode or height in headerStyle to avoid glitches.
Animations can be customized per screen using cardStyleInterpolator and transitionSpec.
Detach inactive screens to improve performance, but disable for transparent modals.
